card.summary: Lets an agent read scanned forms, receipts and PDFs, so it can work with the text and fields in them.
card.example: An expense claim arrives as a photo of a receipt. The agent reads the date and the total from it.
cost: Billed for each page that is read.
needs: A person checks anything the reader is unsure about.
card.safety: It would read documents only inside your private network, and it would not keep them unless you decide it should.
